scope: Current CT desktop readiness/Start alignment and closed rejection diagnostics. Separate from persistent authentication, unattended access, deployment, controller use and game memory acceptance.
behavior: Readiness, session binding and initial broker admission share current owner, finite administration, conversation, endpoint and effective audience predicates.
Selected-setup readiness checks current digest, compatible descriptor, transport scope and finite expiry without starting a driver. sessionReady distinguishes this from current session metadata.
Privacy withdrawal also fences an active transport. A saved personal endpoint cannot substitute for a current declaration after backend restart.
Closed rejection codes are retained in composition status and emitted before cleanup/dialog. Raw exceptions, setup/response bodies and credentials are omitted.
Cleanup and Start-menu disablement occur before an owned failure modal. Stop is independent of modal dismissal; overlapping callbacks do not dispatch another Start.
Windows and macOS source package allowlists include both new main-owned modules. No new renderer Start, setup, audience declaration or generic fetch API.

firstValidationFailure: The new endpoint agreement test first observed a generic rejection at the prevalidated binding gate. That gate now records context_unavailable; the subsequent complete focused run passed.
preflight: LS-S066 preflight retains historical packet/scope/current-change mismatches. The public bounded CT aid was refreshed; private specification and pending whole-slice acceptance were preserved.
ownerActionAfterCutover: After the final backend restart, sign in in the native window only if administration is expired. If audience is unknown and the owner is actually alone, choose Only me — 5 minutes, then obtain fresh ordinary readiness before one bounded Start. Stored Session disclosure can be retained if still current. No automatic declaration or expired-evidence restoration.
stagingOrder: Prepare and validate all source, packages, native pins and inert runtime prerequisites first. A single owner interaction can follow the final backend cutover. Declaring before a later restart cannot qualify that restarted backend; rollback or another restart invalidates it again.
remainingQualification: Coordinated final backend cutover, actual current owner auth and fresh audience choice, finite native attachment and observation. No live retry was performed.
